claim_boundary: This artifact is an acquisition handoff only. It contains no real measured campus × meal-period × service rows, proves no source access, and is not benchmark, pilot-evidence, savings, or operational-readiness evidence until real measured records and source ownership are verified.

actual_served.availability_semantics: Must be measured or reconciled after the service and must never be treated as known at the decision cutoff.

produced_portions.availability_semantics: Must represent actual produced portions for the same campus × meal period × service date and may become available only after production is recorded.

surplus_or_waste.availability_semantics: Must be an accepted measured surplus/waste outcome tied to the same service; TrayGate percentage outputs are not mass or gram truth without separate measured calibration.

shortage_or_early_sellout.availability_semantics: Must be a post-service reconciled outcome or timestamped incident record; absence of a record cannot be silently interpreted as no shortage.

operator_status_quo_quantity.availability_semantics: Must be the quantity estimate or plan actually available before the registered decision_cutoff_at, preserved with an immutable timestamp/snapshot.

menu.availability_semantics: Only a menu snapshot demonstrably published or available no later than decision_cutoff_at may enter historical decision inputs.

academic_calendar.availability_semantics: Use only the calendar/version known by decision_cutoff_at; later corrections must not leak backward into historical features.

weather_forecast.availability_semantics: Use only an immutable forecast snapshot demonstrably issued and available no later than decision_cutoff_at; later observations, reanalysis, or revised forecasts must not leak backward into historical decision inputs.

acquisition_questions.actual_served: Which operational owner and source can export or measure actual served portions per campus × meal period × service date, with a stable source record ID?
acquisition_questions.produced_portions: Which kitchen record, counter, or operator-owned source provides actual produced portions at the same service granularity, and when does that value become available?
acquisition_questions.surplus_or_waste: Which accepted measurement process provides surplus portions or waste mass for the same service, and what reconciliation/calibration rules define an accepted outcome?
acquisition_questions.shortage_or_early_sellout: Where are shortage or early-sellout events recorded, who reconciles them, and how can absence versus missing data be distinguished?
acquisition_questions.operator_status_quo_quantity: What quantity did the operator or existing process plan before each service, where is that plan recorded, and can its pre-cutoff timestamp be preserved?
acquisition_questions.menu: Can the official or operational menu history be exported as immutable snapshots with publication/availability timestamps proving what was known by each decision cutoff?
acquisition_questions.academic_calendar: Which official calendar snapshot/version was available before each historical decision cutoff, including later correction/version history where relevant?
acquisition_questions.weather_forecast: Which archived forecast provider can supply the exact forecast snapshot issued and available before each historical decision cutoff, with immutable content, issue/availability timestamp, and source/version identity?

produced_portions.source: Production Count Node or an existing deterministic kitchen production record/export
produced_portions.evidence_boundary: Architecture candidate only; not accepted operational truth until ownership, measurement procedure, identity mapping, timestamps, and reconciliation are verified.

actual_served.source: Serving Line Counter or an existing aggregate serving/POS export
actual_served.evidence_boundary: Candidate measurement path only; no assumed access, accuracy, or campus deployment.

surplus_or_waste.source: TrayGate plus an accepted surplus/waste reconciliation process
surplus_or_waste.evidence_boundary: TrayGate admission/inference contracts do not prove field accuracy or convert leftover percentage to mass without measured calibration.

required_next_evidence: Confirm the operational owner/source for every required field.
Obtain several chronological real measured campus × meal-period × service rows with immutable source IDs/snapshots.
Verify field availability timestamps relative to decision_cutoff_at and reject future leakage.

Obtain archived weather forecast snapshots that were actually issued and available before each historical decision cutoff; do not substitute later observations or reanalysis as if they were forecasts.
Determine whether reservation data exists outside the documented Kilyos holiday workflow before using reservation features elsewhere.
Determine whether timestamped BUCampus/menu rating history can be exported.
Verify served, produced, shortage/sellout, and surplus/waste reconciliation at service granularity before enabling benchmark or pilot eligibility.
